target_text: Japanese transports and retiring bombardment force off Guadalcanal; seven transports sunk or set afire, beached ships at Tassafaronga later destroyed
source_locator: R2232: ch. 2, The Battle for Guadalcanal
notes: Craven and Cate, vol. IV, ch. 2: on 14 November 1942 dive and torpedo bombers from Henderson Field (short-legged SBDs and TBFs) pounded the retiring bombardment force and then the approaching transports, sinking or setting afire seven transports; the four that beached near Tassafaronga were destroyed from the air and by artillery and surface fire. The source does not name a single squadron, so the mission is entered on 1st MAW, the on-island air command. Confidence 0.7. Base claim for 1st MAW on 14 November is in force.
